definitions: To grant a franchise to; to admit to citizenship, and to the enjoyment of the privileges of a citizen, including the right of voting.
To set free, as from slavery or bondage; to emancipate.
To invest with a franchise or with the rights and privileges of a freeman.
examples: The new law will enfranchise thousands of young adults.
The movement sought to enfranchise all citizens, regardless of race.
Historically, many groups fought to enfranchise themselves.
